scope: Observed-failure-scoped value correction with frozen encoder, constructor and demand model; selection-only replay and paired original Train/Dev evaluation. Controlled documents and responses only.
deploymentStatus: Publicly composable accepted v2/42; offline GPU reproduction and CPU CLI passed

scoped-v1.scope: Train-only recovery-scoped residual with the same actual returns and saved batch draws. Scope depends only on latest observed failed replies and unresolved own state. Prior, encoder and GRU are frozen. Actual sequential Train outcomes are the later primary filter; cached refit scores are diagnostics.

plan.scope: Frozen prior plus numeric correction, activated only when the latest observed financial/demand reply failed or was partial and the own constructed field remains unresolved. No future availability, labels, identifiers or outcomes in the gate. Same 1204 states, 11044 actual parent continuation returns, fitting families, batches, optimizer and budgets as prior residual. New flag is derived from the already stored observations; cached encoder/numeric features are unchanged.
plan.innerGate: Select earliest strictly best held family-balanced target loss within 40 epochs. All three seeds must improve over their exact parent initialization without worsening either benchmark or false handoffs. Parent encoder saw these Train sources; this is not an independent generalization estimate.
plan.refitGate: Refit all Train with identical full-control draws and each fixed inner-selected epoch; preserve all 40 epochs, final weights and optimizer. Refit cached target non-regression is diagnostic, not an eligibility filter in this new protocol. Require frozen prior and exact normal-state output preservation in all candidates.
plan.nextStage: After all inner gates, evaluate parent, full-refit seeds 42/43/44, and failure-aware checklist on original 514 Train episodes with four common new response draws (seed 503) and extra no-dropout retail. Every trained seed must improve at least one actual benchmark total versus parent, worsen neither generated nor retail totals, parameters/state/evidence, false handoffs or resolved-field requests, and retain no-dropout necessary requests and recovery. Baseline holds only when expected-loss ordering lacks an observed failed mandatory field, cannot hand off or retrieve, and that channel cannot be queried again; otherwise uses the existing checklist. Baseline comparison is required evidence, not assumed weaker.
plan.devGate: Only if actual Train gates pass: freeze fixed refit/42 and all three seeds, evaluate original generated Dev and 16 shared retail response masks plus public document retention. All seeds must worsen no parent economic total/parameter/state/evidence/safety metric and improve at least one actual total; retain no-dropout required requests/recovery. Compare the failure-aware checklist. No selection of another seed or epoch from Dev. If performance matches the checklist, do not claim an extra benefit of learned values. No Test or frozen 27-source holdout inference.

plan.scope: Selection-only replay of v1 after discrete held action loss tied early while a fitting b-failure state was not yet learned. V1 sequential Train gate remains failed and no Dev was run. plan.innerGate: Lexicographic selection: first minimize held family-balanced action-target loss (tolerance 1e-10), then minimize held family/benchmark-balanced continuous critic loss (smooth L1 plus the same rank weight). No training-family loss or downstream outcomes select epochs.

limitations: V1 actual Train gate failed; v2 checkpoint selection was separately registered before its learning replay and subsequent Train outcomes. V1 is not retrospectively passed.
Each Train comparison uses fresh paired response draws; compare candidates with their own parent, not totals between response seeds.
V2 final weights match v1 exactly for all six training runs; only held continuous-loss tie breaking and resulting selected epochs changed.
Parent encoder had seen the Train families; source-held action-head selection is not independent generalization.
Original Dev was repeatedly used for development; this is not a new blind evaluation.
Exact retail losses use only five complete periods from four sources, giving 35 conditions; censored periods remain separate.
Compare the same-parent observed-failure rule as well as a failure-aware checklist before crediting learning.
Generated Dev is 60 cases from 12 families. Public extraction, demand calibration and the historical frozen Test threshold remain unresolved.
